definitions.explanation: A young horse, typically one that has not yet reached maturity. Can refer to both colts (male) and fillies (female).

examples.japanese: {子馬|こうま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
{子馬|こうま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{母馬|ははうま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧そば⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}っている→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: The foal is running alongside its mother.

examples.japanese: ⟦{牧場|ぼくじょう}→牧場：06103_bokujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{子馬|こうま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|さわ}る→触る：00808_sawaru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できて→できる：00557_dekiru⟧、{子|こ}どもたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大喜|おおよろこ}び→大喜び：28880_ooyorokobi⟧だった。
examples.english: The children were thrilled to be able to touch the foals at the ranch.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ (young, small) + ⟦{馬|うま}→馬：01865_uma⟧ (horse). Follows the common pattern of ⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ + animal to indicate a young animal.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{子犬|こいぬ}→子犬：19393_koinu⟧ — puppy
- {子猫|こねこ} — kitten
- ⟦{子牛|こうし}→子牛：27912_koushi⟧ — calf
- {親馬|おやうま} — parent horse
- {母馬|ははうま} — mare (mother horse)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Horses have a long history in Japan, particularly in ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧ where horse breeding is still a major industry. The {日高|ひだか} region is famous for thoroughbred breeding.
